summary: Accept both Fabric native client URI service names in Rust and Node clients

replay.detail: No claim history or projection changes.

schema.detail: No stored schema or gateway setting changes.

rules.detail: Trusted peer resolution, pairing authentication and client route restrictions are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Rust and Node native readers accept exactly st3-client-v0 and fractal-client-v0 URI services. Both dial the exposed st3-client-v0 gateway service. Formatters and gateway defaults still emit st3-client-v0; exposure is unchanged. Other services and URI suffixes remain refused, including trailing line breaks.

manual.detail: No configuration edits or additional gateway exposures are required.

recovery.detail: No saved endpoint or gateway settings are rewritten. Older clients still require the st3-client-v0 URI spelling.
